editorial.name: Path
editorial.descriptionZh: 外包修图服务：剪裁路径、去背、图像蒙版、阴影、ghost mannequin、矢量转换等电商产品图处理，下单后最快 6 小时交付。给电商卖家、服装品牌和产品摄影团队。
editorial.takeawayZh: 下单前先看它把十项修图服务排成一页可逐个展开的目录
editorial.noteZh: 首屏标题 Get perfectly edited images in as little as 6 hours，下面一行小字挂着 Selling on Shopify? Scan your product catalog free with Path Catalog Health →，右侧两个按钮 Get my image edits 与 Get 2 free edits。导航分 How it works / Image editing services / Apps / Credits / Pricing / Blog / Help，右上角还能切 USD、AED、AUD、BDT、BRL、CAD 等十几种货币。正文 Image Editing services 一节把 Clipping path、Background removal、Image masking、Shadow、Ghost mannequin、Symmetrical edit、Color change、Photo retouching、Vector conversion、Multi-clipping path 十项逐条列出，页脚另有 Path credit bundles 和 Trustpilot 评分，标题区还写 Path has saved 40,000+ businesses valuable time and money。

reasons.statement: 站内 /pages/clipping-path、/pages/background-removal、/pages/vector-conversion 等页交付的都是修好的图，用户来这里拿走的是把产品图交出去处理这件事本身，所以归图像、矢量与版式创作。
首页写 Starts at 25¢ per edit，是可下单的付费服务，不是可下载的素材或模型，因此不归 visual-assets。
